🇷🇺 ❌ 🇵🇱 — An unidentified object fell into a field near the village of Nowy Lipowiec in Poland's Biłgoraj County on Friday morning, several hundred metres from the nearest buildings. No injuries were reported. Photos published by Polish outlet Wirtualna Polska (WP) show the impact site, with flames burning inside a crater and metal debris scattered across the surrounding field. Residents reported hearing an explosion and seeing smoke in the area. Earlier, air raid sirens sounded across the Lublin region, and Poland's Government Security Centre issued an aerial threat warning. The military prosecutor's office is investigating the incident amid suspicions of a violation of Polish airspace. The nature of the object remains unknown.
